settings.heading: Real Feedback From Professionals We've Worked With
settings.content: Below is a sample of the kind of feedback we hear from clients across industries and career stages. As we collect verified reviews, this page will be updated to feature real, attributed client stories.

settings.heading: What Clients Say
settings.subheading: Feedback representative of the results professionals typically report after working with Hire Nestt.

settings.name: S. Malik
settings.quote: The resume was rebuilt around my actual achievements, not just my job titles. I started getting more callbacks within a couple of weeks.

settings.name: J. Okafor
settings.quote: I'd been applying for months with no response. The ATS optimization made an immediate difference in how many recruiters reached out.

settings.name: M. Alvarez
settings.quote: Clear process, fast turnaround, and the writer actually asked good questions before starting. Two revisions were more than enough.

settings.name: R. Chen
settings.quote: The LinkedIn rewrite was the real win for me — recruiter messages picked up almost immediately after the profile went live.

settings.name: T. Nguyen
settings.quote: I had almost no work experience to point to. They still built a resume that made my internships and coursework sound genuinely relevant.

settings.name: D. Osei
settings.quote: Professional, on time, and the formatting held up perfectly when I uploaded it to different company portals.

settings.name: L. Kowalski
settings.quote: I used the Job Hunter Bundle and finally had a resume, cover letter, and LinkedIn profile that all told the same story.

settings.name: P. Fernandes
settings.quote: The Executive package included a consultation call that genuinely shaped how we framed my last two roles. Worth it.

settings.heading: Write Your Own Success Story
settings.text: Start with the package that matches your goals — and see the difference for yourself.
